verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents non-interactive automation paths. These include API-key Bearer auth for the v2 REST API, separate test-mode (`cal_`) and live (`cal_live_`) secret keys, documented rate limits, and an official Cal.com CLI that agents on a machine can use and that handles authentication and versioning automatically. Together these let it be driven headlessly from scripts or CI. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance or examples, in-depth CLI documentation beyond a brief mention, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
